description: This Java class, TaxComponentHelper, provides utility methods for creating and handling tax components within the Fineract platform's integration tests. It includes methods for constructing JSON representations of tax components, creating tax components via API calls, and generating request data maps.

classes.name: TaxComponentHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing tax components in integration tests within the Fineract project.

methods.name: createTaxComponent
methods.description: Creates a new tax component via API call using the provided request object.

methods.name: getTaxComponentAsJSON
methods.description: Builds a JSON string for a tax component, optionally including account ID details.

methods.name: getBasicTaxComponentMap
methods.description: Generates a basic map of properties for a tax component, including a random name and date info.
